question: Should this release reject both previously shipped keys and remove their exported Plugin SDK type properties, relying on Doctor cleanup as the upgrade path?
rationale: Tests can prove rejection and repair mechanics, but only an owner can accept the user and external-plugin compatibility boundary for this release.

options.title: Require upgrade proof
options.body: Add focused Doctor upgrade coverage and a redacted CLI transcript for both keys, then land the canonical removals with the compatibility impact acknowledged.

options.title: Accept the break now
options.body: Land the current patch and intentionally require affected users and plugin consumers to remove the obsolete fields during upgrade.

options.title: Retain narrow SDK compatibility
options.body: Reject the keys at runtime but preserve a deprecated Plugin SDK-only compatibility type until a later removal window.

recommendation.title: Require upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Add focused Doctor upgrade coverage and a redacted CLI transcript for both keys, then land the canonical removals with the compatibility impact acknowledged.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available owner from recent Doctor migration and config-contract history.
